reasoning: The message asks for something to be done now — a pass over the prover skill — so by the act table it is an Instruction: 'asks for something to be done' → 'accept the work, state the goal understood, begin'. The word 'только' narrows the scope of what is being asked for; the situation is 'choosing what this session will cover', so nothing is yet in flight for it to narrow — 'When no work is in flight yet, the same message is an idea or an instruction — decide which by whether they are asking for it now', and 'Сделай' asks for it now. So it is not a correction and attaches to no existing work. One turn, one act: there is no musing, no standing rule ('always', 'from this point on'), no reported fact, and no conditional branch, so nothing else to name and shelves_idea is false. Taking acts apart is not splitting a goal — 'One instruction stays one piece of work even when it will touch six files' — the pass over one skill is a single result someone could want on its own, hence work_items 1. creates_work true, so by the operation ladder the ticket is admitted and taken in hand in one call: ['T1','T2']. Dimensions are named only where something must change: a review pass over a skill changes the skill text and what it guarantees — documentation and communication, and quality/regressions in what the skill enforces; nothing in product behaviour, user path, architecture or analytics is claimed to change, and 'if nothing in it changes, do not name it'.
